shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上摆着移液管、移液器和容量瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench with glass pipettes, a micropipette and a volumetric flask and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲移液器具和标准溶液。

shots.scene: 量筒、移液管、微量移液器、容量瓶四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a graduated cylinder, a glass pipette with a bulb, a micropipette and a volumetric flask. No people.
shots.narration: 量得准，配得准。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一只烧杯，正对着烧杯上的刻度倒液体
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pours liquid into a beaker and squints at the volume marks on its side.
shots.narration: 阿杰要配溶液，拿烧杯就量。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着烧杯刻度直皱眉，小研走过来摇头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at the rough marks on the beaker; the female graduate student walks over and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研摇头：这样量，误差太大了。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰一个吸耳球，指着台上的量器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a rubber pipette bulb and points at the measuring tools on the bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：量器有讲究，要选对。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们从选对量器开始。

shots.scene: 实验台上一排各种玻璃仪器
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench lined with many kinds of glassware: beakers, flasks, cylinders and pipettes. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃仪器各有用途，量体积也一样。

shots.scene: 小研举着锥形瓶，看侧面的刻度
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, goggles and gloves holds up an Erlenmeyer flask and looks at its side marks.
shots.narration: 烧杯、锥形瓶上的刻度只是个大概。

shots.scene: 宽口烧杯和窄管的液面示意：同样高度差对应的体积差别很大
shots.prompt_en: A diagram comparing a wide beaker and a narrow tube: the same small height error covers a large volume slice in the beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 口径宽，读错一点，体积就差很多。

shots.scene: 用烧杯量取的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker used for accurate measuring, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 要量准，别用烧杯量。

shots.section_title: 量筒更准，但小体积有限
shots.scene: 量筒刻度特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the dense blank scale lines on a graduated cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 量筒细、刻度密，误差小得多。
overlay: 量筒更准，但小体积有限

shots.section_title: 量筒更准，但小体积有限
shots.scene: 一排大小不同的量筒，最小的里面只有一点液体
shots.prompt_en: A row of graduated cylinders of different sizes; the smallest holds just a tiny bit of liquid with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 可量很少的液体，量筒也不够准。

shots.section_title: 容量瓶准，但只有一个体积
shots.scene: 小研摊手介绍台上的容量瓶，箭头指向瓶颈刻线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gestures to a volumetric flask on the bench; an arrow points to the single line on its neck.
shots.narration: 容量瓶的刻线，代表一个准确体积。
overlay: 容量瓶准，但只有一个体积

shots.section_title: 容量瓶准，但只有一个体积
shots.scene: 一只容量瓶旁边几个不同体积的问号
shots.prompt_en: A volumetric flask next to several question mark bubbles of different sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 可一只瓶只能量一个体积。

shots.section_title: 移液器具：从微升到几十毫升
shots.scene: 从微小液滴到大量液体的刻度条
shots.prompt_en: A horizontal scale bar going from a tiny droplet icon to a large liquid column icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要又准又灵活，就用移液器具。
overlay: 移液器具：从微升到几十毫升

shots.section_title: 移液器具：从微升到几十毫升
shots.scene: 小研从支架上取下一支微量移液器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a micropipette from a pipette stand.
shots.narration: 从几微升到几十毫升，都能量准。

shots.scene: 移液管剖面示意：下面是管，上面是吸取装置
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a pipette: a long tube below and a suction device on top, with an up arrow and a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 移液器具，一根管加一个吸取装置。

shots.scene: 液体被吸入管中，再放到另一个容器
shots.prompt_en: Liquid rises into a pipette from one beaker, then the pipette moves and releases it into another beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 吸到需要的量，再放到别的容器。

shots.scene: 几种外形不同的移液工具并排
shots.prompt_en: Several different pipetting tools lined up: a glass pipette, a pump, an electric pipette controller, a dropper and a micropipette. No people.
shots.narration: 种类不少，用法各有不同。

shots.scene: 小研举起一根玻璃移液管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a long glass graduated pipette.
shots.narration: 化学实验室常用玻璃移液管。

shots.scene: 玻璃移液管旁的体积范围图示
shots.prompt_en: A glass pipette icon next to a range bar from a small mark to a larger mark. No people.
shots.narration: 能转移一毫升到几十毫升。

shots.scene: 小研把移液管上端插进吸耳球
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fits the top end of a glass pipette into a rubber bulb.
shots.narration: 先把移液管上端插进吸耳球。

shots.scene: 手捏扁吸耳球排出空气
shots.prompt_en: Gloved fingers squeeze the rubber bulb flat to push the air out. No people.
shots.narration: 捏扁吸耳球，排出空气，别松手。

shots.scene: 管尖伸进溶液，慢慢松开吸耳球，液面上升到刻度
shots.prompt_en: The pipette tip goes into a beaker of purple solution; the bulb slowly relaxes and the liquid rises to a mark. No people.
shots.narration: 伸进液体，慢慢松开，到刻度就停。

shots.scene: 移到另一个烧杯上方，挤压吸耳球放出液体
shots.prompt_en: The pipette moves over another beaker and the bulb is pressed to release the liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 移到目标容器，挤压放出。

shots.scene: 小研用带旋轮的移液泵吸液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a pipette pump with a thumb wheel to draw liquid slowly.
shots.narration: 想更准，可用移液泵，吸放更慢更稳。

shots.section_title: 电动移液器适合重复量取
shots.scene: 小研按下电动移液器的按钮，液体自动吸入
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses a button on an electric pipette controller and liquid is drawn up automatically.
shots.narration: 电动移液器，按一下就能吸、能放。
overlay: 电动移液器适合重复量取

shots.section_title: 电动移液器适合重复量取
shots.scene: 一排试管依次被加入液体，旁边计数图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of test tubes is filled one after another, with a counter icon going up. No people.
shots.narration: 反复量取很多次，用它省力。

shots.scene: 小研举起一支一次性塑料滴管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a disposable plastic dropper.
shots.narration: 量更少的液体，常用一次性塑料滴管。

shots.scene: 塑料滴管管身上的刻度特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the blank scale marks on the stem of a plastic dropper. No people.
shots.narration: 转移少量液体很方便，有的还带刻度。

shots.scene: 玻璃滴管和塑料滴管并排，一瓶溶剂只对玻璃打勾
shots.prompt_en: A glass dropper and a plastic dropper side by side; a solvent bottle icon shows a green check toward the glass one only. No people.
shots.narration: 有些液体不能碰塑料，要用玻璃滴管。

shots.scene: 小研清洗玻璃滴管后放进存放架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses a glass dropper and places it in a storage rack.
shots.narration: 玻璃滴管能重复用，用完洗净收好。

shots.scene: 无刻度滴管把液体转进带刻度的量筒
shots.prompt_en: A dropper without marks transfers liquid into a graduated cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 没刻度的，就转进有刻度的容器。

shots.scene: 小研平视着向试管中一滴一滴加液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles, adds solution drop by drop into a test tube at eye level.
shots.narration: 也可以一滴一滴，慢慢加入。

shots.scene: 二十个小液滴汇成一个量筒刻度
shots.prompt_en: Twenty small drop icons merge into one marked level in a small cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 经验上，二十滴大约一毫升。

shots.scene: 约等号旁有一个问号
shots.prompt_en: An approximately equal sign with a small question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 只是估计，不能当准确量。

shots.section_title: 微量移液器要定期校准
shots.scene: 小研手持微量移液器，旁边是试管架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a micropipette next to a rack of small tubes.
shots.narration: 小体积精确量取，用微量移液器。
overlay: 微量移液器要定期校准

shots.section_title: 微量移液器要定期校准
shots.scene: 微小液滴图标和几次重复的相同液滴
shots.prompt_en: A tiny droplet icon repeated three times, all exactly the same size, with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 能准到一微升，次次都一样。

shots.section_title: 微量移液器要定期校准
shots.scene: 老李在天平旁校准微量移液器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a micropipette by weighing dispensed water on a balance with a blank display.
shots.narration: 前提是定期校准，才能一直准。

shots.scene: 小研转动旋钮设定体积
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the volume knob of a micropipette to set a blank display.
shots.narration: 先设定好要量的体积。

shots.scene: 移液器轻压装上一次性吸头
shots.prompt_en: The micropipette presses gently onto a disposable tip in a tip box. No people.
shots.narration: 装上一次性吸头。

shots.scene: 拇指按下活塞，吸头伸入溶液
shots.prompt_en: A thumb presses the plunger down, then the tip is placed into the purple solution. No people.
shots.narration: 按下活塞，再把吸头伸进溶液。

shots.scene: 慢慢松开活塞，吸头吸入固定量液体
shots.prompt_en: The thumb slowly releases the plunger and the tip fills with a fixed amount of liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 松开活塞，自动吸进设定的量。

shots.scene: 移液器在试管里放出液体
shots.prompt_en: The micropipette dispenses the liquid into a small tube by pressing the plunger again. No people.
shots.narration: 不用盯着刻度停，按下就放出。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一瓶贴空白标签的溶液
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a bottle of clear solution with a blank label.
shots.narration: 标准溶液，就是浓度准确已知的溶液。

shots.scene: 已知瓶和未知瓶之间的天平式比较图
shots.prompt_en: A diagram with a known solution bottle and an unknown sample flask linked by a comparison arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 用它来测定未知物的浓度。

shots.scene: 一瓶白色粉末的空白标签试剂瓶，旁边一个滴定管图标
shots.prompt_en: A jar of white powder with a blank label next to a burette icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这次配0.1摩尔每升的KHP溶液。

shots.scene: 容量瓶图标旁有浓度图示
shots.prompt_en: A volumetric flask icon with a small concentration label area left blank. No people.
shots.narration: KHP是酸碱滴定里常用的酸。

shots.scene: 小研在天平上用称量纸称取白色粉末
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student weighs white powder on weighing paper on a balance.
shots.narration: 称取约5克KHP粉末。

shots.scene: 粉末倒进烧杯，加水和搅拌子
shots.prompt_en: The powder is tipped into a beaker; water and a stir bar are added, and it stirs on a stirrer. No people.
shots.narration: 倒进烧杯，加水，用搅拌子搅溶。

shots.scene: 计算示意：粉末堆、摩尔质量图标、容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: A calculation diagram: a powder pile, an arrow to a molecule icon, an arrow to a volumetric flask. No people.
shots.narration: 按摩尔质量，算出物质的量。

shots.scene: 容量瓶图标上标出250毫升
shots.prompt_en: A volumetric flask icon with its fill line highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 定容到250毫升，浓度正好。

shots.scene: 小研把溶液经玻璃漏斗缓缓倒入容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student slowly pours the solution through a glass funnel into a volumetric flask.
shots.narration: 溶好后，经漏斗慢慢倒进容量瓶。

shots.scene: 小研用洗瓶冲洗烧杯，冲洗液也倒入容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses the beaker with a wash bottle and pours the rinse into the flask.
shots.narration: 用洗瓶冲洗烧杯，冲洗液也倒进去。

shots.scene: 烧杯壁上残留的小颗粒被冲走
shots.prompt_en: Small leftover particles on the beaker wall are washed away by a stream of water. No people.
shots.narration: 一点都不能落下。

shots.section_title: 定容：弯月面与刻线相切
shots.scene: 小研用洗瓶往容量瓶里加水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adds distilled water to the volumetric flask with a wash bottle.
shots.narration: 用洗瓶加水，加到接近刻线。
overlay: 定容：弯月面与刻线相切

shots.section_title: 定容：弯月面与刻线相切
shots.scene: 小研弯腰平视刻线，用滴管逐滴加水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student bends down to eye level with the line and adds water drop by drop with a dropper.
shots.narration: 最后几毫升，改用滴管一滴滴加。

shots.section_title: 定容：弯月面与刻线相切
shots.scene: 弯月面最低点刚好与刻线相切的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the bottom of the meniscus exactly touching the line on the flask neck, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 弯月面最低点与刻线相切，就停。

shots.scene: 小研捧着配好的容量瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds the finished volumetric flask of clear solution.
shots.narration: 标准溶液配好了。

shots.scene: 大容量瓶和微量移液器配小管的对比
shots.prompt_en: A large volumetric flask next to a micropipette filling a small tube. No people.
shots.narration: 量少的标准溶液，可用微量移液器配。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现烧杯打叉、量筒和容量瓶打勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons: a beaker crossed out, a cylinder and a volumetric flask with checks.
shots.narration: 量准体积，别靠烧杯刻度。

shots.scene: 移液管配吸耳球、滴管、微量移液器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glass pipette with a bulb, a dropper and a micropipette with a tip. No people.
shots.narration: 移液管、滴管、微量移液器，各有所长。

shots.scene: 称量、溶解、转移、定容四步图标
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons with arrows: a balance, a beaker on a stirrer, a funnel into a flask, and a flask filled to the line. No people.
shots.narration: 称量、溶解、转移、定容到刻线。

shots.scene: 标准溶液瓶和未知样品瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a standard solution bottle with a blank label and an unknown sample flask with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 标准溶液，用来测未知浓度。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着贴好标签的容量瓶挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a labeled volumetric flask and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 一滴不差，配得精准，再见！
